factual_claims.claim: Loan issuances reached an all-time high of EUR 458.0 million, up 24.3% from EUR 368.6 million in 2024, with vehicle and device finance issuances growing 34.0% and consumer finance issuances 15.7%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'In 2025, Eleving Group repeatedly achieved record-high loan issuance volumes, issuing EUR 458.0 million worth of loans to its new and existing clients—an increase of 24.3% compared to the EUR 368.6 million in 2024. factual_claims.claim: The Group expanded its product and geographic footprint by launching installment loans in several European markets, smartphone financing in Kenya and Uganda, and motorcycle financing in Tanzania, its seventeenth market.

In 2025, Eleving Group started offering installment loans in Latvia, Estonia, Romania, and Armenia.'

factual_claims.claim: Smartphone financing reached a EUR 13.5 million portfolio by year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report: 'By the year end, the smartphone financing portfolio had reached EUR 13.5 million and served 260 thousand customers.'

factual_claims.claim: The Group also sold a EUR 12.4 million vehicle-finance portfolio in Moldova and reviewed its Uzbekistan business model.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management report under 'Operational Milestones': 'In Moldova, Eleving Group operated two separate business units... In line with its ongoing efforts to optimize operational efficiency, Eleving Group has initiated a review of the business model of its Uzbekistan operating entity.'

factual_claims.claim: Capital access strengthened through a EUR 40 million bond tap and a EUR 275 million five-year bond issuance, which refinanced EUR 150 million of maturing debt.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED

factual_claims.claim: Total borrowings principal reached EUR 441.6 million, with EUR 50.4 million due for renewal within 12 months.

factual_claims.source_evidence: Going concern section: 'As at 31 December 2025, the principal of Group’s total borrowings amounted to EUR 441.6 million of which EUR 50.4 million is due for renewal over the following 12 months.'

factual_claims.claim: The Group paid EUR 19.65 million in dividends and received a positive outlook revision from Fitch while retaining its B rating.
